# Swap BNB — BNB Smart Chain Swap Reference

> Exchange BNB for USDT, stablecoins and BEP-20 tokens on BNB Smart Chain through a non-custodial decentralized exchange. Independent, not affiliated with Binance.

## Key Facts
- Asset: BNB — native gas token of BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20 standard)
- Network: BNB Smart Chain (EVM-compatible); BNB also on legacy BNB Beacon Chain
- Gas: paid in BNB
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Approvals: buying a BEP-20 with native BNB needs no approval; selling a BEP-20 for BNB needs a one-time approval
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas (BNB) + price impact; gas usually low
- Common route: BNB -> USDT / stablecoins / BEP-20 tokens
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Binance
